nodes.label: Single Page Application Architecture
nodes.rationale: The app is a SPA contained in a single www/index.html (HTML+CSS+JS inline) wrapped by Capacitor as a native Android app. This avoids a separate build pipeline while leveraging native device APIs through Capacitor plugins.

nodes.label: localStorage Persistence
nodes.rationale: Survey answers and user points stored in localStorage via Capacitor Preferences, persisting between sessions without a backend.

nodes.label: ECA-Aire Peruvian Air Quality Standard
nodes.rationale: DS 003-2017-MINAM standard; PM2.5 limit of 25 µg/m3 used as the chart threshold and alert trigger throughout the app.

nodes.label: Simulated IoT Sensor Data
nodes.rationale: No real backend or IoT API exists in this MVP; all sensor node data (PM2.5, CO2, UV, Ozone, Temp) are generated via JavaScript random jitter on top of SCENARIOS constants.

nodes.label: AI Route Scoring Model
nodes.rationale: Weighted scoring: Contamination 35%, Accidents 30%, Traffic Flow 20%, Incidents 15%. Simulated street data for Tacna streets.

nodes.label: Waze-inspired Brand Color Palette
nodes.rationale: UI color palette explicitly modeled after Waze brand colors (cyan #23AABA, dark backgrounds) for recognizable navigation-app aesthetic.
